summary: Iteration 37 — Retest of tasks-only manager UI after /auth/login & /auth/register fix. ALL CHECKS PASS. Backend sanity: POST /api/auth/login for a tasks-only manager now returns user.acting_as = {owner_id, owner_name, money: false}; /auth/me returns the same. FRONTEND tasks-only manager: tab-budget hidden; hero shows project-stage-progress (30% of stages done) with subtitle 'Tasks access · money figures hidden' instead of project-total-spent; add-expense-button, budget-details-link, receipts-see-all are all absent; quick actions = ['quick-action-snags'] only (ai/brrr/report/receipt filtered out); Media screen renders only media-tab-photos chip (media-tab-receipts hidden); Profile exposes no BRRR calculator or Share report rows (only profile-link-ai remains, which is the general AI assistant link, not BRRR; the only 'BRRR' text on screen is inside the generic Pro upgrade marketing card). Switching back to the manager's own seeded project (POST /projects/{pid}/activate via tapping the project row) restores tab-budget, project-total-spent, add-expense-button, budget-details-link, receipts-see-all and the full quick-action set (ai/brrr/report/receipt/snags). REGRESSION demo owner (demo@mybuilder.app) shows tab-budget, project-total-spent, 42% used budget bar, add-expense, budget-details, receipts-see-all, and quick actions ai/report/receipt/snags — unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/auth.py register & login now call user_out(u, await effective(u)) — confirmed by curl: manager /auth/login returns acting_as.money=false. The one-line fix on each endpoint is the correct minimal patch.
Frontend money.ts hook (user?.acting_as?.money !== false) now receives the correct value on fresh login because auth.tsx handle() stores response.user, which now contains acting_as.

profile.tsx row filter `(money || !['brrr','share'].includes(r.id))` correctly suppresses the BRRR calculator and Share report rows when money=false — verified in UI (no profile-link-brrr/share testIDs rendered for manager).
(tabs)/_layout.tsx filters out budget tab when money=false — verified: tab-budget absent for tasks-only manager, present after they switch to their own project.
